name: Pinterest
tagline: Create, manage, and analyze Pins and boards via Pinterest's official developer platform.
description: Pinterest's REST API lets developers create and manage Pins, boards, and ads; fetch user and catalog data; and run analytics for businesses. Access is via OAuth 2.0 apps in the Pinterest developer portal, with endpoints for organic content, advertising, and commerce use cases under published rate limits.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 access token in Authorization: Bearer header; register an app in the Pinterest developer portal (developers.pinterest.com).

use_cases: get authenticated Pinterest user account profile
list boards for a connected Pinterest account
create a Pin on a board from an image URL
fetch Pin analytics for a business account
search Pins by keyword for content discovery
